# /sw:deslop

Measures spacing, alignment and execution of the rendered page, element by element, at several widths, with screenshots.

Arguments: `$ARGUMENTS`. Talk to the user in the project's report language.

Run from the project root (the folder with `.quality/project.json`):

```bash
node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sw.mjs" deslop $ARGUMENTS
```

If the command needs an address and none was given, take it from `.quality/project.json` › `urls` (`local` first, then `staging`) and pass it; if there is none, ask the user. The app must be running at that address.

If Playwright is missing, ask the user whether to run `/sw:browser-setup` (pack cache, not the project).

Then read the JSON the command printed (and the file it names, and the screenshots if any) and tell the user, briefly: what passed, what failed and where, what was not checked. Open the screenshots before concluding. Fix with the deslop-ui skill, "high" findings first.
